summary.text: Joanna McClinton is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 191, which she has represented since August 2015, and is the Speaker of the House. She is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: McClinton received a B.A. in political science from LaSalle University and a J.D. from the Villanova University School of Law.
Her professional experience includes working as an assistant public defender and as chief counsel to state Sen. Anthony Williams.
McClinton was first elected to the House with 71% of the vote in a 2015 special election following the resignation of Ronald Waters.
She served as House Democratic Caucus Chair from 2018 to 2020 and as House Democratic Leader from 2020 to 2023.
She was first elected House speaker on February 28, 2023, becoming the first woman to hold the position, and was re-elected speaker in 2025.

McClinton told the National Conference of State Legislatures in 2024 that her legislative priorities would be changing the criminal justice system and ending a cycle of underinvestment in communities of color.
